title: Spoor
subtitle: Where ideas leave a trace
_comment: English V2 subtitle/voice-over track. Same pacing as spoor-promo-v2-zh.json (0–59s, 8 segments, ~30fps). Mirrors the concrete 'places & memory' story from the en-v2 copy bundle: place attachment, the damp hallway, the childhood home. Drop an English voiceover at audio/en-v2.wav and the renderer will pick it up automatically.

timestampSegments.en: Some questions don't arrive because we're looking for them. They arrive because a place returns.
timestampSegments.zh: 有时候，我们只是突然想到一个问题。

timestampSegments.en: Put the question on the canvas. Say it out loud, in whatever shape it takes.
timestampSegments.zh: 不用先想好结构。把你脑子里的那句话说出来。

timestampSegments.en: Talk it through with Ali — not to think for you, but to dig where you're stuck. The place isn't the only thing you remember. It's the life that happened there.
timestampSegments.zh: 然后，让 AI 帮你去找。百科、文章、图片、视频……你需要的东西，可以直接带回画布。

timestampSegments.en: Let Ali go looking. Encyclopedia, articles, images, video — brought straight back onto the canvas.
timestampSegments.zh: 然后，让 AI 帮你去找。百科、文章、图片、视频……你需要的东西，可以直接带回画布。

timestampSegments.en: And not just the web. Your own photos, notes, files — and the sentences you haven't quite finished — they belong here too.
timestampSegments.zh: 还有你过去的旧照片、随手记下的碎片……别担心乱，全铺在这里。

timestampSegments.en: When the canvas is full, circle what actually matters for the writing ahead. The threads are already there.
timestampSegments.zh: 思绪全在眼前了。圈出真正打动你的那些，脉络就自然浮现出来。

timestampSegments.en: Hand the important pieces to AI. It composes the article — but every key idea still traces back to where it came from.
timestampSegments.zh: 最后，把真正重要的内容交给 AI，让它帮你整理成一篇文章。而文章里的每一个重要想法，都可以回到它最初的来源。

timestampSegments.en: From a single idea, to a long-form essay.
timestampSegments.zh: 从一个想法，到一篇长文
